summary: All 11 plan phases completed, including the two OPTIONAL ones (10 and 11). Seven new Lean modules (Semantics/Correspondence/{Galois,Indicator,DurationFrames,FwdRec,FwdRecPeriodicity,FwdRecBridge} and Metalogic/Independence/{StaticFrame,RationalWitness,LexIntWitness}) plus two in-place edits (Theorems/DiscreteUnfolding.lean's succIndicator generalized to succIndicatorAt; Theorems.lean's summary line). ~2450 lines of Lean, sorry-free, no new axioms, every headline result profiling as [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Delivered: the Th/Mod adjunction with galoisClosed_of_indicator factored exactly once; indicator exactness (IND-D, IND-F, the guarded IsDiscrete form) and both closure corollaries; the static-frame constant-truth untl/snce calculus at arbitrary D; both non-closure witnesses (staticFrame over Q for Dedekind, over Z x_l Z for Discrete) with both AxiomSet sandwiches, the Discrete upper bound obtained semantically and independently of the Derivable-level route; the three (T1) correspondence theorems for DF/DN/CO over the translation and permissive witness frames, with the (T0) refutation recorded; and the FwdRec correspondence at both strengths, atomic at arbitrary D and full-schema at Z via the Walk/MinCyc apparatus. The concurrency contract held: FormalSystem/ was mine alone for the whole run, every phase was committed as it went green with targeted pathspecs, and no git add -A or commit -a was used.
